notes: The state figures come from the Chief Electoral Officer's press notes of 16 December 2025 and 21 February 2026. The split between the two districts is the Chief Electoral Officer's data as the press reported it.
The names left off by sex are the roll before less the draft, for men, women and third gender, from the same press note.
Absent, permanently shifted and other reasons are counted together as shifted, absent or other. The five reasons add exactly to the names left off.
After the draft, 12,166 names were added. 3,812 were deleted on forms and 35,780 were found ineligible after notices to unmapped electors and those with logical discrepancies.
Of the electors on the draft, 1,82,403 could not be mapped to an earlier roll and 58,923 had logical discrepancies.

The Chief Electoral Officer's last bulletin on claims and objections, of 20 January 2026, counts 8,176 applications to be added (Form 6 or 6A) and 8,066 objections (Form 7) from electors themselves, and 2,279 objections from parties' booth agents, 2,258 of them from the BJP's.
cannot_show: No table by constituency of the roll before, the draft, the names left off or the final roll was found on the Chief Electoral Officer's site.
The Chief Electoral Officer's site prints electors by constituency only for the roll of 1 July 2026, which includes later additions, so it is not shown against the revision.
The reasons and the changes after the draft were published for the state only.
No count of notices issued was published, only the number of electors in each category that could receive one.
